title: euphorbia cotinifolia subsp. cotinoides
intro: Euphorbia cotinifolia subsp. cotinoides, commonly known as Red Birdcage, is a species of flowering plant in the spurge family (Euphorbiaceae) that is native to tropical Africa. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including reducing inflammation, fighting oxidative stress, and exhibiting antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Red Birdcage include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antiviral activities, which may help alleviate symptoms of certain health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
